name: blueprint/codebase-audit
description: Inspect a codebase with numbers: rh_run the metric tools (pygount/cloc/git), keep one receipt per measure, summarize the shape, and store the report - the audit is a build, not a vibe.
use_cases: a snapshot to diff against next month
ingredients: rh_run pygount / cloc / git log stats
recipe: run the metric commands (bounded collect) -> receipt per measure -> summarize: languages, LOC, ratios, churn -> store audit:<repo>:<ts> { measures, note } -> diff against the previous snapshot
result_kind: one audit record per repo per run, diffable
pitfalls: exit code is the verdict - a missing tool is a red receipt, not a guess
receipts are per measure, so a partial run is still evidence
the snapshot only means something next to the previous one
keep tails short - the summary is the deliverable
